title: Normalized successive Kummer root-chart specification
statement: Fix a commutative condensed coefficient ring and ordinary internal modules and their unbounded derived categories [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. A normalized successive Kummer chart is the following specification, with no existence assertion or chosen substitute data. For an actual full parameter-root chart [def-sfb-tame-root-chart-geometry], [def-sfb-full-parameter-root-tower] and a disjoint outer/inner partition, retain the continuous coordinate reordering of its native deck group and the successive inner-then-outer root algebra equivalence, fixed on coefficients and every named root. A shared environment retains the existing full bar and product bar [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data], [lem-sfb-condensed-product-bar-comparison], their specified invariant adjunctions, exact inflation equality, nonnegative-resolution augmentation comparisons and their naturality on every compatible resolution lift. Its iterated-invariant identification is the inverse inner-first total identification followed by canonical transport to the ordinary degree-zero object, with exact point pullback to the boundary. For a finite norm-continuous E-representation and a normed field map E to F, use the existing all-continuous condensation [def-sfb-finite-continuous-kummer-coefficient-model] and existing commutative ring bundle [def-sfb-kummer-coefficient-models]. Retain an actual lisse extension with its full profinite-family coefficient linearization [def-sfb-profinite-coefficient-linearization], equivariant puncture restriction and point-pullback identification. The puncture identification for derived descent is precisely the canonical composite of these identifications using actual inverse-image comparisons. The product action is the native root action through the coordinate reordering. Its actual double geometric nerve has parameter schemes G_o^a times G_i^b, all action first faces, multiplication/deletion faces and identity-insertion degeneracies specified as scheme-map equations; its diagonal is identified with the actual full root Cech nerve by the canonical coordinate map [def-sfb-kummer-nerve-coordinates]. Retain the actual normalized coherent resolved full-nerve descent [def-sfb-kummer-normalized-chart] using the actual chart-open maps [def-sfb-kummer-chart-geometry-maps], together with a resolved successive geometric descent [def-sfb-kummer-successive-descent] on that same nonnegative resolution. Its coherent roof has every actual counit/evaluation column square [def-sfb-kummer-parameterized-term], both actual geometric augmentations, diagonal-source gamma and its augmentation and pulled-back theta equations. The full geometric comparison equals the diagonal geometric augmentation under the specified full-bar identification. Finally retain actual normalized restricted charts after every boundary map, whose comparison is the exact Cartesian pullback of the original comparison, using the specified composition and invariant-pullback transports [def-sfb-kummer-refinement]. The successive augmentation arrow separately restricts by the canonical derived pullback and point-pullback transports, with a resolved geometric model on every restricted boundary. The full-root coordinate equations and actual geometric double-nerve specification are those of [def-sfb-kummer-partial-nerve-coordinates].
